Gateway derives authenticated CompanionId; spoofed companion/binding/principal/role/trust fields and cross-companion same-contact IDs deny without disclosure. Crashes or lost acknowledgments at local prepare, gateway fence/result, local commit, and gateway finalize resume the exact intent or remain visibly over-fenced/manual_hold; changed reuse denies. Canonical contact mutation and phase transition commit atomically under exact version CAS with no out-of-transaction reads. Verification cannot grant fleet authority before exact ownership commit and cannot manufacture binding/role. Unlink clears legacy Discord identity and no lookup recreates it. Duplicate-primary same-principal/cross-principal conflicts follow explicit tested semantics. Focused RPC/Postgres/crash/race tests, build, mandatory lint, exact UBS v5.3.5, and dual blind P0/P1 review pass.

title: Add exact verified contact ownership and durable lifecycle ledger
description: Summary: Add the companion-owned durable half of the contact lifecycle saga. Current contact_channel_ids rows lack version, verified state, verification provenance, and restore state; countVerifiedIdentityLinks counts historical links rather than proving that one exact current contact owns a verified Discord subject. Add versioned exact ownership records, contact authority versions, verification IDs/digests, live/quarantined state, a lifecycle intent ledger with canonical request JSON/digest, active target locks, phases, results, retry lease/backoff, and typed pending/manual-hold outcomes. The companion prepare transaction deterministically locks affected contacts/subjects, captures exact versions and verified ownership, and stores the immutable intent before any gateway call. Same intent/digest resumes; changed reuse denies. Restored ownership/intents remain quarantined. Scope: focused contact migrations, strict shared contract consumption, ledger/snapshot/coordinator/recovery modules, typed ContactStorePort outcomes, and tests. Non-goals: fleet_auth SQL, gateway receipts/fences, generic outbox framework, role/trust mapping, usernames, Garden routes, or performing canonical merge/delete/unlink yet. Avoid expanding crud-operations.ts; place new persistence in focused postgres-adapter lifecycle modules and import migrations into the canonical contact migration list.
acceptance_criteria: A locked snapshot proves exact companion-local contact ID plus stable Discord subject plus current identity version plus verification ID/digest plus contact authority version and live restore state; total counts and usernames are never proof. Strict schema and parser tests reject unverified/deleted/reassigned/restored/stale ownership, cross-companion contact collisions, unknown fields, and malformed versions. Prepare atomically writes canonical intent/digest, exact target locks, versions, phase, and lease; same digest resumes and changed reuse denies. Pending and manual_hold are visible typed outcomes with intent ID/phase/reason. Restore quarantines verified ownership and in-flight intents before any reapproval. Startup recovery can claim bounded leases and malformed/corrupt durable state fails closed. Regression-first Postgres/race/restore tests, build, mandatory lint, exact UBS v5.3.5, and dual blind P0/P1 review pass.

title: Implement gateway contact-lifecycle fences and replayable authority receipts
description: Summary: Add the gateway half of the OPL1.5.3 two-phase contact-authority protocol. A thin call to authorityLifecycle.execute is unsafe because point-in-time revocation releases its transaction before the companion contact commit, permits new binding/reapproval races, requires a human actor unavailable to automated contact recovery, and stores uniqueness-only rather than replayable results. Implement a bounded contact-specific authority service with strict v1 canonical request/result contracts, gateway-derived CompanionId, durable receipts keyed by companion ID plus intent ID plus request digest, exact recorded phase/result replay, changed-reuse denial, and active/terminal contact/subject fences checked by binding activation, first-owner, reapproval, authorization resolution, and every authority-creating path. Gateway derives a constrained system-companion action for destructive merge/delete/unlink/conflict fencing; the agent cannot submit principal/session/role/trust/binding claims. Destructive prepare revokes/suspends current authority and keeps the fence through finalize; verification/reapproval prepare reserves conflicts but cannot activate authority until exact companion post-state finalize. Unbound contacts return durable no_binding only after an active fence exists. Scope: focused shared contract, gateway service/port, fleet_auth receipt/fence migration/store, bounded OPL1.5.2 lifecycle integration, audit/backup/restore/reconciliation, and focused tests. Non-goals: companion contact database ledger/mutations, generic distributed transactions, HTTP/WebAuthn UI, raw Pool exposure, or agent-chosen CompanionId. Likely files: src/shared/contracts/contact-authority-lifecycle.ts, src/boundary/gateway/contact-lifecycle-authority-port.ts, focused fleet-auth contact bridge store/migration, and narrow integration with authority lifecycle/first-owner/reapproval/resolver.
acceptance_criteria: Strict contracts reject unknown fields and any supplied companionId, principal/session/binding/grant/role/trust/username claim. Gateway derives authenticated CompanionId and constrained action. Same companion+intent+digest replays the exact durable phase/result after restart or lost acknowledgment without repeating mutation; changed reuse and cross-companion reuse deny. An active fence blocks concurrent first-owner, binding activation, reapproval, session/role authorization, and other authority creation for the exact contact/subject. Destructive no_binding is recorded only behind that fence. Verification/reapproval cannot activate before finalized exact companion proof. Terminal merge/delete/unlink fences and non-restored authority survive rollback/old restore; restored receipts/fences quarantine safely. Redacted structured audits distinguish exact intent/action/resource/phase. Regression-first Postgres/race/rollback/restore tests, backup verification, build, mandatory lint, exact UBS v5.3.5, and dual blind P0/P1 review pass.

title: Wire the unified HTTPS origin, deployment, rollback, and OPL1.6 E2E
description: Summary: Expose fleet login, authenticated fleet shell, each authorized companion Garden, and optional Companion UI through one repo-owned HTTPS origin after the gateway authenticates the browser, compiles a canonical route capability, resolves OPL1.5 authorization, signs an operator capability, strips browser credentials/assertion headers, and proxies only to the exact internal companion. Unknown/unauthorized companions must deny before any upstream connection without fleet enumeration. Establish an explicit trusted-proxy TLS/Host provenance contract so OAuth callback validation works behind repo ingress while spoofed Forwarded/X-Forwarded headers fail. Remove direct Garden ingress/host-port and ADMIN_TOKEN/psfn_token authority in enabled fleet mode; restrict operator/agent paths by network policy and mTLS. Preserve feature-disabled parity and document repo-owned rollback. Scope: focused gateway SSO router and wiring, channel API bootstrap transition, operator surface verification, Helm workloads/ingress/network policy/values/validation, launcher wiring, deterministic two-companion process E2E, setup/operations rollback docs. Non-goals: OPL1.8 portal UX, OPL1.12 full certification, OPL1.18 device identity, or OPL1.5.4 WebAuthn ceremonies. Likely files: new src/boundary/gateway/fleet-sso-router.ts, gateway main/api-surface, channels API fleet-auth routes/server, operator main/surface, deploy/helm/psfn templates/values, verify-helm-chart, start-gateway-agent.sh, focused fleet-sso process harness, docs/setup.md and docs/operations.md.
acceptance_criteria: One repo-owned production HTTPS origin serves /fleet, /companions/<RFC4122>/garden, and optional /companion-ui. One login reaches only authorized companions; unknown/unauthorized routes/actions/queries deny before upstream connection and do not enumerate membership. Direct Garden access is absent in every supported production mode, including feature-off legacy-token operation; legacy byte parity may remain only gateway-mediated or internal/loopback, never as a second public privileged edge. Forged host/forwarded host, callback confusion, open redirects, cross-companion capability, target/action/query/resource/body substitution, replay, parent-to-agent forwarding, WS query secrets, logout/revoked sessions, fixation, and cookie theft deny. Two principals with disjoint companions and identical relative filenames/IDs cannot cross-read or cross-write filesystem, shell cwd, images, Beads, attachments, or channel artifacts, and revocation terminates continuing access. Internal operator/agent paths are mTLS/network-policy restricted. Feature-off behavior remains byte-compatible at the supported mediated boundary. Repo Helm/launcher/rollback configuration is authoritative; fleet-on and fleet-off chart renders prove no direct Garden ingress/service reachability. Helm validation, targeted E2E, settings contract where touched, repository hygiene, build, mandatory lint, exact UBS v5.3.5, and dual blind P0/P1 review pass.

title: Add atomic capability replay and broker-authorized child assertions
description: Summary: Implement transactional consumption for signed request capabilities and a gateway broker exchange that reauthorizes operator-to-agent child work. mTLS/SPIFFE authenticates processes but not the browser-authorized action; an operator assertion must never be forwarded to an agent. Store global issuer+jti consumption with exact target/audience/companion/parent/decision digests and durable consume result. First concurrent consume wins; byte-identical retry returns the recorded result without redispatch; mutated or cross-audience/companion reuse denies. The operator requests a new aud=agent:<companionId> assertion over authenticated control-plane transport; the gateway verifies the live parent decision, exact operator identity, principal/companion, current authority versions, and exact child action/resource before issuing a new jti linked to the parent. Strip every inbound browser assertion-like header; WebSocket assertions travel only in internal headers, never query strings. Scope: migration, replay store, child assertion broker service, bounded gateway persistence ports, operator/gateway authenticated control client, operator/agent transport enforcement, integration/race tests. Non-goals: public reverse proxy/Helm, portal UX, contact lifecycle RPC, WebAuthn, or device identity. Likely files: migrations.ts, request-capability-replay.ts and tests, src/boundary/gateway/fleet-auth-child-assertions.ts, fleet-auth-broker.ts, gateway-persistence.ts, operator garden transport client/server, focused startup support.
acceptance_criteria: Atomic global issuer+jti consumption permits exactly one concurrent first consume. A byte-identical transport retry returns the durable recorded consume result without redispatch; any target/body/audience/companion/action/resource/parent mutation denies and audits. Agent rejects operator-audience capabilities. Child minting requires authenticated operator identity, a live exact parent decision, same principal/companion, current authority versions, and fresh exact child reauthorization; child gets a new jti and linked parent, and the operator removes the parent before the agent hop. All browser-supplied assertion headers are stripped and WebSockets accept authority only via internal headers, never URL query. Regression-first Postgres/transport/race tests, build, mandatory lint, exact UBS v5.3.5, and dual blind P0/P1 review pass.

title: Implement Ed25519 hop request-capability signing and verification
description: Summary: Turn the existing unused fleet-auth Ed25519 private-key/public-keyring configuration into a strict hop-specific human request-capability protocol. Define a bounded canonical token signed only by the gateway and verified by operator/agent public key rings. Bind exact issuer and kid, audience, companion, method, canonical path/query, typed action/resource, exact body digest, request/decision/parent IDs, authority versions, jti, iat/nbf/exp, and target digest. Operator capabilities use aud=operator:<companionId> and forbid parent claims; agent capabilities use aud=agent:<companionId> and require exact parent linkage. Current hub-device assertions are a separate authority domain and must not be generalized. Scope: focused request-capability schema/signer/verifier, config issuer/key ownership hardening, active/retiring overlap and emergency revocation, gateway-only signer factory and bounded ports, golden cryptographic fixtures. Non-goals: replay database, reverse proxy, child issuance service, hub-device rewrite, key-generation ceremonies, WebAuthn, or UI. Likely files: src/boundary/fleet-auth/request-capability.ts plus tests, src/system/config/fleet-auth-config.ts plus tests, focused signer factory under src/persistence/postgres/fleet-auth, bounded wiring in gateway-persistence.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Strict Ed25519 fixtures accept a valid canonical capability and independently reject forged/noncanonical signature, unknown or revoked kid, wrong issuer, expired/not-yet-valid token, wrong audience/companion, changed method/path/query/action/resource/body, changed request/decision/jti/authority versions, and parent mismatch. Active and retiring public keys verify during overlap; emergency-revoked keys fail after the supported restart/reload contract. Regression-first focused tests, build, mandatory lint, exact UBS v5.3.5, and dual blind P0/P1 review pass.

title: Define canonical fleet SSO request targets and route capability catalogue
description: Summary: Define one strict, shared compiler for every fleet-forwardable Garden HTTP and WebSocket request. The compiler must validate method, canonical normalized path, exact duplicate-rejecting query schema, bounded body policy and digest, typed action, typed resource selector, companion, and request target before authorization or upstream connection. Current Garden route declarations carry only matcher/handler while handlers parse URLSearchParams ad hoc; duplicate, unknown, ambiguous, encoded-slash/backslash, dot-segment, duplicate-slash, and sensitive-ID substitution semantics are not canonicalized. Scope: new focused request-capability-target and garden-route-capabilities modules, shared golden conformance tests, route matcher hardening, route declarations for every public Garden UI/API/WS endpoint, and adapters so gateway/operator/agent derive the same target from actual bytes. title: P1: Compose fleet authorization resolver with lifecycle provenance and counters
description: Summary: Blind review of OPL1.5.2 found that its exact multi-provider session provenance and principal-wide lifecycle counters do not yet compose with the separate OPL1.5.1 authorization-context resolver. The resolver currently requires exactly one active provider subject, directly equates binding/grant resource-local versions to principal-wide session counters, and requires every principal/binding/grant authority_generation to equal the latest global generation. After provider.add, binding activation, role grant, or any unrelated principal revocation, these contracts can deny otherwise current authority or fail to consume merge/companion lifecycle state. Why: OPL1.5.1 and OPL1.5.2 are individually fail-closed, but their assembled production contract must authorize the exact current session/provider/binding/grant without bricking multi-provider or unaffected accounts, while still denying stale, merged, removed, restored, or revoked authority. Scope: after both streams are integrated, adapt the Postgres authorization-context snapshot and domain provenance to select the browser sessions exact active/live provider subject; treat session binding/grant/policy values as principal-wide invalidation counters rather than resource versions; validate resource-local lifecycle/version independently; consume immutable principal merge aliases and companion_authority_state; and use the non-restored floor plus exact current central/session/principal counters so unaffected old row generations can remain valid without allowing stale affected authority. Add regression-first multi-provider, activation/grant, unrelated-revocation, merge, companion remove/readd, restore, floor-race, and lock-order tests. Non-goals: change role policy, add HTTP proxy routes, implement WebAuthn/ceremony UI, weaken global session epoch fencing, or fold the separate correlation-audit leak psfn-framework-dut9.2 into this work. Files: src/persistence/postgres/fleet-auth/authorization-context-store.ts, src/boundary/gateway/fleet-authorization-context.ts only if the immutable context provenance must expand, OPL1.5.2 schema/session/lifecycle contracts as integrated, and focused composition tests.
acceptance_criteria: With multiple live Discord subjects, a session resolves only the exact provider and subject recorded on that session; provider substitution denies. Newly activated bindings/grants and new sessions authorize when principal-wide counters are current even when resource-local versions differ, while stale sessions or mutated resources deny. A lifecycle change for principal A does not permanently brick a fresh current session for unaffected principal B merely because B rows carry an older authority_generation. Merged source principals, removed/quarantined companions, restored rows, tombstoned resources, and stale floor/epoch/version states deny. Lock order remains authority then session/principal then exact provider then companion/binding/grant/evidence, with post-commit floor recheck. Focused Postgres/race tests, build, mandatory lint, exact UBS v5.3.5, and two blind final reviews have no unresolved P0/P1 finding.

title: P1: Prevent caller-controlled authorization correlation data from leaking secrets
description: Summary: The OPL1.5.1 final review found that src/boundary/gateway/fleet-authorization-context.ts accepts any 1-128 character control-free correlationId from unknown caller input, while src/persistence/postgres/fleet-auth/authorization-context-store.ts persists that value verbatim in authorization_audit_events. Scope: make authorization correlation gateway-authored or persist only a domain-separated cryptographic digest so unknown request input cannot choose raw audit bytes; preserve safe traceability across allow decisions, semantic denials, infrastructure denials, and post-commit authorization-floor denials; add regression-first adversarial coverage proving supplied secret and identity values never appear raw in the audit table. acceptance_criteria: Regression-first tests demonstrate that correlationId values equal to a session token, evidence identifier, provider subject, and contact identifier never appear raw in authorization_audit_events; stored correlation is gateway-generated or a domain-separated cryptographic digest and remains consistent enough for traceability; allow, ordinary deny, infrastructure-deny, and post-commit floor-deny paths all preserve redaction; malformed inputs fail closed; focused tests, build, npm run lint, exact UBS v5.3.5, and two independent blind final reviews have no unresolved P0/P1 finding.

title: Complete OPL1.5 ceremonies after unified origin and strong assurance
description: Summary: Complete the final reachable OPL1.5 provider/contact/role ceremony composition after the per-companion authorization resolver, atomic lifecycle authority, durable contact bridge, unified trusted HTTPS origin, and OPL1.10 strong-assurance service are integrated. Wire first-owner bootstrap, ordinary first link, provider add/relink/replacement, current-subject-unavailable recovery, and restore reapproval through focused HTTP/domain composition without expanding gateway main, server, or broker god files. Reuse the OPL1.5 lifecycle state machine and OPL1.10 assurance; do not duplicate WebAuthn, role, or fencing policy. Require current companion/contact validation immediately before activation, exact provider+principal+companion+contact+role tuple binding, fresh database-clock expiry after all relevant locks, exact session rotation/fencing, and one structured redacted allow/deny audit contract carrying provider, companion, contact, role, ceremony, authority/binding/grant/session versions, policy version, and decision. First-owner SQL currently checks expiry using caller-supplied p_at before row-lock work; add lock-wait-past-expiry regression and use fresh database time before making this path reachable. Production must remain bootstrap-only/principalAuthenticationWired=false until every required resolver, assertion, operator-verification, and ceremony route is reachable. Files likely include src/channels/api/server/fleet-auth-routes.ts, focused route/composition modules, src/boundary/gateway/fleet-auth-broker.ts, src/persistence/postgres/fleet-auth/first-owner-sql.ts, reapproval.ts/reapproval-sql.ts, audit persistence/schema, gateway-persistence composition, and focused tests. Why: staged first-owner and restore mechanisms currently fail closed but are unreachable, non-login OAuth kinds reject, and activation does not yet recheck live companion-owned contact truth. Non-goals: implement OPL1.6 origin/signing, duplicate OPL1.10 WebAuthn/JIT policy, weaken first-login pending/no-role, turn contact trustLevel into operator role, allow approval/passkey enrollment alone to elevate, or expose direct agent fleet_auth access.
design: Compose existing authorities: OPL1.6 supplies trusted-origin and signed-hop context; OPL1.10 supplies user-verifying strong assurance and trusted-host confirmation; OPL1.5.1 supplies immutable per-companion authorization context; OPL1.5.2 supplies the sole atomic lifecycle/fencing state machine; OPL1.5.3 supplies current versioned contact truth and durable cross-process lifecycle. Route handlers parse and authenticate only, then call a focused ceremony service. Database transitions recheck current rows and fresh database time under deterministic locks. Denial audit is durably appended outside a rolled-back mutation transaction without converting denial into success. Unknown ceremony kinds and incomplete dependency composition reject.
acceptance_criteria: First-owner bootstrap is production-reachable only through matching OAuth stable subject, user-verifying OPL1.10 WebAuthn, explicit trusted-host confirmation, exact companion/contact/owner tuple, atomic single-use consume/audit, a fresh no-active-owner recheck, and fresh database-clock expiry after locks; mismatch, replay, concurrency, and lock-wait-past-expiry deny. Ordinary link/add/relink/replacement proves the initiating/current and new stable subjects, uses OPL1.10 for privileged principals, checks exact current contact/version/conflicts, rotates or fences sessions, and records approval; unavailable current authentication permits only an audited trusted-host recovery that fences old authority first. Restore reapproval checks the exact current companion-owned contact snapshot/version immediately before activation. Every allow and deny decision writes the structured redacted audit fields without secrets. Pending login, passkey enrollment alone, approval alone, restored state, newly attached subjects, username/header claims, stale versions, and unknown actions never grant authority. Disabled mode retains legacy behavior; enabled incomplete composition remains fail-closed. Focused route/domain/Postgres race/restore tests, production reachability tests, build, mandatory npm run lint, UBS, two blind reviews, and final seam review pass with no P0/P1 or Charter finding.

description: Summary: The existing real-process ICP certification harness fails immediately on the s10mc.2.1 prerequisite because it starts child agents without performing the new explicit operator-owned Postgres tenant provisioning step. Reproduction from commit cca9a4b7: npx vitest run src/app/e2e/icp-certification/process-harness.integration.test.ts -t "boots one real socket gateway and two schema-isolated SubstrateAgent child processes". Child startup fails in src/persistence/postgres/tenancy.ts:140 with "PostgreSQL tenant boundary for certification_companion_a is not explicitly provisioned". Files: src/app/e2e/icp-certification/process-harness.ts starts shared Postgres services and child agents; src/app/e2e/icp-certification/fixture.ts defines certification schemas and credentials; src/persistence/postgres/tenancy.ts owns the explicit provisioning contract. Required fix: update only the repo-owned disposable certification harness to execute the operator provisioning API for both fixture schemas, grant the disposable runtime login membership, relocate vector to the extensions schema, and grant only approved shared-schema access before child startup. Preserve production fail-closed startup: do not add runtime auto-provisioning or fallback behavior. Scope: certification harness and regression coverage only. Non-goals: production provisioning CLI changes, live/Pi/SSH work, provider routing changes, or weakening assertPostgresTenantAccessProvisioned.
design: Call the canonical planPostgresTenantAccess/provisionPostgresTenantAccess API from the disposable process harness after shared-schema stores exist and before any child agent starts. Resolve the actual disposable login role from current_user instead of assuming a credential name. Keep the fix in its own commit before s10mc.8 validation harness work.

A regression assertion proves the harness provisioned the roles/boundary. Production agent startup remains preflight-only and still fails closed when provisioning is absent. Focused tests, full npm run lint, npm run build, and git diff --check pass for the fix.
close_reason: Completed in f77c41b2. src/app/e2e/icp-certification/process-harness.ts:454-471 resolves the actual runtime login role and uses canonical planPostgresTenantAccess/provisionPostgresTenantAccess with vector relocation and approved shared read_write before agent startup. title: Make owner-file migration bootstrap and partial copies crash-recoverable
description: Summary: The r11o owner-file migration still wedges permanently across documented crashes. system-owner-fleet-migration-io.ts rejects an incomplete receipt-owned temporary copy left by the explicit during_temporary_copy crash on every retry. system-owner-fleet-migration-execution.ts also creates exclusive quarantine/staging directories before the first durable receipt, so a crash in that window strands artifacts that every retry rejects as pre-existing conflicts. Introduce a durable bootstrap ownership state before any migration-owned directory creation and make partial-copy retry safe without trusting or deleting an unidentified replacement. Preserve all descriptor/inode/symlink/TOCTOU protections and exact-source retirement. Scope: receipt state model, directory bootstrap ordering/recovery, partial-copy continuation or safe supersession, cleanup/finalization, docs, and crash tests. Non-goals: weakening conflict denial, path-based check-then-delete, trusting prefix names, or silently cleaning unknown files.
design: Persist and fsync a bootstrap receipt/intent in the already-pinned trusted receipt directory before creating staging/quarantine leaves. Bind every later directory and temporary file to an unpredictable receipt-owned identifier and record its expected identity before relying on it. For an incomplete copy, either resume through the exact already-open/identity-matched object or durably supersede it with a new receipt-owned object while preserving the unidentified/old object for quarantine; never path-check then unlink a possibly replaced leaf. Recovery must distinguish owned partial state from external conflict using durable receipt data and pinned identities.
acceptance_criteria: A crash/restart at every boundary from durable bootstrap intent through quarantine/staging directory creation, mid-temporary-copy, fsync, publish, source quarantine, receipt update, and finalization either resumes to one correct completed migration or safely denies an identified external replacement. No crash before the first in-progress receipt can strand a directory that blocks retry. A partial receipt-owned temporary cannot wedge retry and is never mistaken for or deleted after replacement. Unknown/pre-existing artifacts still deny. Directory/source/destination/staging/receipt/quarantine identities remain pinned and rechecked; exact source inode/digest retirement and replacement preservation+deny remain intact. Adversarial crash/symlink/swap/replacement tests, build, and mandatory npm run lint pass.

title: Retire Discord evidence lifecycle on terminal authority reset
description: Summary: Successful fleet provider revocation deletes Discord evidence snapshots/lifecycle fences and reconciliation may delete fences globally, but DiscordEvidenceLifecycleCoordinator retains affected active entries and renewal timers. The next timer or Discord authority event mutates a missing durable fence; failEntry retries revocation, aggregates the second failure, and the default queueMicrotask background handler throws an uncaught exception that shuts down the gateway. Implement one serialized terminal-authority-reset path that cancels timers and removes affected or all local active entries whenever provider authority/fences are terminally removed. Represent expected external fence ownership loss as a typed terminal result that cleans local state without escalating to the fatal handler; unexpected persistence failures remain fatal. Scope: broker/provider-revoke coordination, lifecycle coordinator/store result contracts, reconciliation/reset integration as required, and regression tests. Non-goals: swallowing unknown database failures or weakening session/evidence revocation.
acceptance_criteria: Provider revocation atomically/deterministically fences durable authority and, through the coordinator serialization queue, cancels the exact principal/provider timer and removes local active/reauthentication state as appropriate. Global authority reset removes every affected active entry. A subsequent scheduled timer or Discord member/observer event is a no-op and cannot crash or restart the gateway. Expected missing/stale fence ownership returns a typed terminal outcome and clears local state; permission, connectivity, corruption, and other unexpected persistence failures still surface fatally. Concurrency tests cover revoke versus timer/event/renewal, duplicate reset, global reset, and rollback behavior. Focused tests, build, and mandatory npm run lint pass.
notes: Implemented in git commit 6dcbe137. Added serialized provider/global reset through the Discord lifecycle queue; typed applied/retired mutation outcomes across Postgres store, runtime, and coordinator; exact/all timer and retained evidence retirement; fatal propagation for unexpected errors; and focused renewal/event/reset/rollback/no-op coverage. Focused test command ran once: 34 passed, 2 Postgres integration tests failed from one missing isRfc4122Uuid import; corrected without rerun per instruction. npm run build passed. npm run lint ran once and exposed psfn-framework-78w8; its one-line correction is included in 6dcbe137, but lint was intentionally not rerun pending full integration lint. Keep open until integration validation.
close_reason: Completed in 6dcbe137 and integrated by d92e1357. Evidence: commit/stat and current terminal lifecycle state/tests were read; exact and global authority retirement cancels timers and retained reauthentication state through the serialized coordinator, typed retired results make stale callbacks no-ops, and unexpected persistence failures still surface. The one focused run passed 34 tests; two Postgres cases failed only from a missing test import that was corrected, build passed, and the later integration lint passed. Final independent review specifically accepted terminal provider/global reset and stale-lifecycle retirement with no P0/P1 or Charter issue; no related integration-suite failure remained.

title: Bridge companion contact lifecycle to fleet authorization
description: Summary: Add the synchronous/durable cross-process lifecycle port that makes companion contact mutations fence gateway-owned fleet authorization before canonical contact state can diverge. Integrate src/core/contacts PostgreSQL merge, delete, Discord identity unlink, and relevant identity-conflict paths with an agent-to-gateway protocol bound to the authenticated CompanionId. The gateway validates the exact companion and calls the opl1.5 authority state machine; the agent persists a durable idempotent intent/result so crash recovery resumes or safely preserves over-fenced authority. Never let contact trustLevel become operator role, never let a caller choose another companion root, and never use usernames for identity. Scope: port/protocol, companion-side durable lifecycle ledger/outbox, gateway RPC handler, contact store wiring, startup/recovery, and adversarial crash/race tests. Non-goals: generic distributed transactions, direct agent access to fleet_auth, provider/WebAuthn ceremony UI, or cross-companion shared contacts.
design: Use a fail-closed saga: prepare an exact idempotent lifecycle intent in the companion schema, ask the gateway to fence/transition fleet authority, durably record the gateway decision, then commit the canonical contact mutation/finalization. Crashes before gateway acknowledgement retry the same request; crashes after fencing may leave authority safely over-fenced but must never leave stale access active. The gateway derives CompanionId from the authenticated agent connection and rejects payload mismatch. Recovery is bounded, observable, and does not invent success.
acceptance_criteria: Contact merge/delete and Discord identity unlink cannot complete while stale fleet bindings, roles, sessions, grants, challenges, or evidence remain usable. Each request is CompanionId-bound, idempotent, versioned, durable across agent/gateway restart, and replay/mutation safe; another companion cannot address or observe it. Crashes at every prepare/fence/contact-commit/finalize boundary recover deterministically or remain safely over-fenced with visible failure state. Duplicate delivery returns the recorded result; changed reuse denies. Contact trust/privacy/relationship state never grants a PSFN operator role. Production startup wires the bridge and its recovery worker without expanding composition god files. Focused RPC, Postgres, crash/race, build, and mandatory npm run lint pass.
notes: 2026-07-16 gap/threat audit: add an exact versioned companion-owned snapshot proving that one current contact owns a verified Discord subject; total verified-link counts are insufficient. Merge, delete, unlink, implicit duplicate-primary merge, verification, and restored-contact reapproval must use the durable authenticated bridge. Test crashes before/after each database commit, idempotent retry, mutated replay, stale assertions, deleted/reassigned/unverified contacts, and cross-companion contact-ID collisions. Partial failure remains visibly over-fenced/pending. The agent never accesses fleet_auth directly and the gateway derives CompanionId from the authenticated connection.

comments.author: axAilotl
comments.text: 2026-07-16 read-only implementation map found three release-blocking P0 design gaps in a thin RPC approach: point-in-time .5.2 revocation lacks an active post-fence creation barrier; automated contact verification/merge/recovery has no human browser actor and must not forge gateway_verified actor/session claims; and binding/reapproval authority must activate only after exact companion contact ownership commits. The bridge therefore requires a two-phase durable saga with gateway receipts/active fences, gateway-derived constrained system actions, companion exact verified-ownership versions, finalize-before-grant ordering, lost-ack replay, visible over-fenced holds, and restore quarantine. Additional P1s: direct legacy Discord fallback can resurrect unlink, current contact mutation reads escape their transaction, unbound contacts need durable no_binding semantics, and current boolean results cannot expose holds. Decomposition into focused child Beads follows; no direct pool or god-file expansion.

title: P1: Recovered attachment delivery bypasses sensitivity egress approval

title: Implement atomic companion binding and role authority lifecycle
description: Summary: Implement the gateway-owned fleet_auth state machine for per-companion contact bindings and base-role grants. Provide focused, typed transitions for initial ordinary binding after an owner exists, role grant/change/revoke, contact/provider unlink, binding conflict suspension, principal merge, contact merge/delete, companion removal, and restore/re-enable quarantine. Every transition must atomically fence affected browser sessions, JIT grants/challenges, Discord evidence, authn/authz versions, binding/grant versions, and the global authority epoch as appropriate, with immutable audit provenance. Historical Discord subjects remain globally unique/tombstoned and cannot move between principals. Scope: state-machine contracts, PostgreSQL transactions/procedures/migrations, bounded gateway persistence port, and adversarial race/restore tests. Non-goals: HTTP/Garden ceremony routes, WebAuthn verification, trusted-host user interface, unified HTTPS proxy, or agent-to-gateway contact transport.
design: Keep transition admission separate from mutation: callers must supply a gateway-internal verified lifecycle decision containing actor principal, exact target principal/provider/companion/contact/role, ceremony kind/id, current authority versions, reason digest, and timestamp. The store rechecks all durable state and versions under locks; caller claims never replace database authority. For contact merge/delete or provider loss, over-fencing is safer than partial reactivation. Unknown actions or impossible state transitions reject. Restored candidates remain quarantined and ordinary transitions cannot activate them.
acceptance_criteria: All named lifecycle transitions have one primary state-machine implementation and reject unknown or stale transitions. Mutations lock/recheck exact principal, provider subject, companion, contact, binding/grant versions, restore state, and authority generation; conflicts or concurrent changes deny. Provider/contact unlink, principal/contact merge/delete, companion removal, and role changes atomically suspend/revoke affected authority and fence sessions, grants, challenges, evidence, versions, and audit state. Provider tombstones remain permanent and cross-principal reuse denies. Restored rows cannot become live through ordinary transitions. No direct raw-pool escape or duplicate policy logic is exposed. Transaction/race/rollback/restore integration tests, build, and mandatory npm run lint pass.
notes:
2026-07-16 gap/threat audit: the lifecycle authority must also model exact multi-provider provenance and revoke, immutable principal source-to-canonical merge aliases with cycle rejection and unchanged historical provider ownership, companion removal/re-add reconciliation, and one structured allow/deny audit contract. Current revoke selects all subjects and mutates rows.at(0), which is unsafe once provider-add exists; browser sessions also lack exact provider-subject authentication provenance. Regression-first cases include current-subject substitution, exact multi-provider revoke, current+new callback binding, replay/concurrent replacement, stale approval/version, role/contact conflicts, principal merge with differing companion roles/contacts, and companion removal/re-add. Reuse existing provider-lifecycle fencing and permanent tombstones; no parallel policy or raw-pool escape.
2026-07-16 implementation evidence: Added migration v13 atomic_authority_lifecycle and one gateway-owned lifecycle state machine covering binding.activate; provider.add/relink/replace/unlink; role.grant/change/revoke; binding.conflict_suspend; contact.unlink/merge/delete; companion.remove/readd; and principal.merge. Admission now strictly validates discriminated decisions, actor/current target/source authn/authz/binding/grant/policy versions, authority generation/global epoch, a live exact-provider actor session, and consumed unexpired gateway OAuth callback rows that durably record the exact verified provider subject. Caller-computable proof digests are checksums only; missing/forged/mismatched callback evidence denies under a database lock, and unique decision/callback receipts prevent replay. Mutations lock/recheck durable authority, use the shared exact provider-revocation primitive and batched non-restored floor fencing, preserve permanent subject ownership, suspend source roles/bindings on immutable cycle-checked principal aliases, quarantine restore/re-add state, fence sessions/JIT/challenges/custody/Discord evidence, advance central versions/epoch, and persist redacted allow/deny audit provenance. Backup snapshot/restore v3 includes companion state, merge aliases, lifecycle audit/counters, with restored rows quarantined. No HTTP/Garden/WebAuthn/OPL1.6/contact-RPC scope was added and no raw pool is exposed.

Regression-first record: authority-lifecycle-types.test.ts initially failed because the module did not exist; authority-lifecycle-store.integration.test.ts initially failed because the store did not exist. Final validation: focused lifecycle types/store/OAuth 27/27 passed; final OAuth+lifecycle 21/21 passed; final lifecycle store 12/12 passed; full fleet-auth schema/migration/backup-restore integration 24/24 passed using local PostgreSQL client wrappers; npm run verify:backup-restore passed; npm run build passed; mandatory npm run lint passed. Exact UBS Meta-Runner v5.3.5 scanned all 24 changed files after final edits (/tmp/opl1-5-2-ubs-final.json): 128 critical, 59 warning, 1439 info aggregate heuristic hits. Manual review found no actionable finding: critical matches were provider/UUID/count/null comparisons and test fixture literals, while warning matches were guarded narrowing, SQL-text function/switch heuristics, and guarded JSON parsing; scanner also confirmed no request-derived raw SQL, tainted source-to-sink path, eval, unbounded body, async error-path, or resource-lifecycle defect. Repository hygiene was also inspected earlier: our introduced dependency cycle was removed by extracting provider-revocation-authority.ts; remaining hygiene failures are unrelated pre-existing public-sanitize, identity-literal, hardcoded-setting, and nine dependency-cycle findings outside this Bead scope. Bead intentionally remains in_progress for orchestrator integration/review and was not closed.

2026-07-16 bounded remediation pass atop f6b9e5fb: reproduced the blind-review failures before production edits, then fixed all six P1 areas. Terminal replay now holds a decision advisory lock across rollback and denial audit, checks the canonical ledger before execution and after rollback, and rejects replays even after receipt reconciliation. principal.merge and companion.remove now create non-restored principal/companion authority-floor tombstones with an atomic DB projection used by direct reapproval SQL and reconciled from the authoritative file. Lifecycle OAuth now has migration-enforced ceremony/action/proof-role/initiating-principal/initiating-session purpose binding, a live broker plus PostgreSQL producer, exact Discord subject evidence, and no login session or provider link side effect. Lifecycle audit schema v2 nulls raw principal/companion columns and commits request-complete redacted digests plus full affected principal, companion, binding, role-grant, and provider before/after snapshots.

OPL1.5.1 integration contract verified explicitly: the initiating session is bound to its exact provider subject; binding and role-grant row versions are separate resource versions and can advance independently of principal counters (role-grant row 7 to 8 while principal grant counter 1 to 2); unrelated durable principal rows are not rewritten to the latest global authority generation (actor remains generation 1 while current floor is 2); only unaffected ephemeral authority attestations such as an actor session epoch are carried to the current epoch and remain unrevoked.

title: Resolve per-companion fleet authorization context
description: Summary: Implement the production gateway-owned resolver that turns an authenticated fleet session plus exact companion target into a bounded per-companion authorization context. Read current fleet_auth principal, Discord provider subject, principal_contact_bindings, principal_role_grants, authority generation, global epoch, and session authn/authz versions through a focused persistence port. Require exactly one live active binding and base role for the requested companion; contact IDs are companion-local and must never resolve across companion schemas. Discord guild/channel/role evidence may only narrow a separately authorized room entry and can never create or widen a contact binding, PSFN role, trust level, memory authority, or device identity. Scope: resolver domain types, store queries, audit reason codes, production broker wiring, and focused integration tests. Non-goals: provider mutation ceremonies, WebAuthn, unified-origin proxying, Garden route matrix, or contact mutation transport.
design: Place policy in a focused boundary/domain service rather than the broker or gateway composition root. Return immutable AuthContext data containing principal, companion, contact, role, session/version/epoch provenance, and optional bounded evidence reference. Treat missing, multiple, pending, suspended, conflict, revoked, quarantined, stale, or restored authority as explicit deny states. The resolver must use database-consistent reads/locks appropriate to prevent authority from changing between decision and returned context; opl1.6 will bind this decision into a signed hop capability.
acceptance_criteria: An active current session resolves only its exact companion-local active/live contact binding and role, with current principal/provider/session authn+authz versions, authority generation, and global epoch. First login remains pending/no-role. Cross-companion contact-ID collisions, absent or multiple bindings/grants, pending/conflict/suspended/revoked/quarantined/restored rows, stale session or versions, provider tombstones, malformed inputs, and unknown companions deny with audited reason codes. Discord evidence cannot manufacture or widen PSFN authority. Production wiring reaches the resolver without expanding a god file. Focused unit/race/Postgres integration tests, build, and mandatory npm run lint pass.
notes:
2026-07-16 gap/threat audit: implement one production resolver and action matrix. Current session validation checks principal/global versions but does not join exact active provider, companion-local contact binding, base role, binding/policy versions, or require one unambiguous live binding. Production returns fleet_auth_principal_resolver_unavailable. Include structured allow/deny audit and keep subject contact distinct from operator role/trust. Regression-first cases: pending/quarantined/conflicting/ambiguous, stale session/generation/version, tombstoned provider, unknown action/companion, same contact ID across companions, wrong audience, spoofed headers, and Discord evidence widening attempts. Do not add migrations in this stream unless a review proves unavoidable; coordinate only the narrow gateway-persistence composition seam with .5.2.
2026-07-16 implementation lane: added a gateway-owned immutable per-companion authorization-context contract/resolver, conservative base-role/action policy intersected with fleet-auth owner-file disables, exact bounded request parsing, and a Postgres REPEATABLE READ/authority-lock snapshot store over the existing schema only. Resolution requires one current active/live principal and Discord subject, exact companion-local active/live binding and role, current session authn/authz/binding/policy versions, current authority generation/global epoch/floor, and optional positive evidence bound to the current config/lifecycle. Structured audit omits tokens/contact/provider subject; semantic denials commit, and a failed allow transaction rolls back before a separate authorization_store_error denial receipt. Regression-first proof: missing module failure before implementation; final focused suite 66/66, including five Postgres/race/rollback/evidence tests; npm run lint and npm run build passed. Exact UBS v5.3.5 scanned all seven changed files: 33 critical/36 warnings, reviewed as generic false positives (decision/status string comparisons misclassified as secret comparisons, fixed Discord token endpoint misclassified as a hardcoded secret, pre-existing broker verify signature/JWT heuristic, switch-return and guarded typed-access heuristics); no actionable finding remained. No migrations/schema, lifecycle mutation, HTTP/signing/WebAuthn/Garden, or OPL1.6 work. Integration hook for the concurrent .5.2 lane: createPostgresFleetAuthorizationContextResolver({ pool, sessionPepper, config, knownCompanionIds, providerRevocationAuthority }) and pass it as GatewayFleetAuthBroker.authorizationContextResolver; gateway-persistence.ts and principalAuthenticationWired remain deliberately untouched for conflict-free integration.
Pushed immutable implementation commit 01b9bb55ae4503cbbc6fbb2e421cf3dbe3223cbb on work/opl1-dnll-opl1-5-1-auth-context; origin-equal and clean. Bead intentionally remains in_progress for integration/review.
2026-07-16 blind review A of b349ae17..01b9bb55: CHANGES_REQUIRED with four independently validated P1 findings. (1) roleAllowsAction grants member garden.read/settings.read/tools.execute even though owner-file config can only narrow the closed code policy; member must be exhaustive self/companion-only. (2) resolvedAt is captured before repeatable-read snapshot/row locks, so a session/evidence can expire during lock wait and still allow. (3) the external non-restored provider floor is checked before audit/commit and can advance while the resolver holds DB locks; a post-commit pre-return recheck with durable denial audit is required. (4) production initializeGatewayFleetAuthPersistence constructs the broker without the resolver, so the new factory is test-only/dead and always returns authorization_context_unavailable. Exact .5.2 integration dependencies remain: session exact provider provenance, per-companion binding/grant/policy counters/fencing, and resolver-compatible lock order. Single bounded remediation assigned; no other blockers, and request parsing/contact-role separation/evidence narrowing/semantic audit redaction were sound.
2026-07-16 single bounded P1 remediation shipped and pushed as 0eae4f5efe66a52828c8bd1cceb98359618a2ef9 on work/opl1-dnll-opl1-5-1-auth-context; branch clean and origin-equal. Role policy is now explicit and default-deny for every role/action pair: owner receives the current closed action set, admin all current actions except provider.link, member only companion.read plus memory.read.self and memory.jit.self, guest only companion.read, with owner-file disables always intersected. The exhaustive regression covers all 4 roles x all 11 FLEET_AUTH_ACTIONS and will deny newly added actions until code policy is explicitly extended. Decision time is captured only after the repeatable-read snapshot has acquired and returned authority, session, principal, provider, binding, grant, and optional evidence locks; deterministic Postgres lock-wait regressions prove session_expired and evidence_stale after time advances during the wait. The non-restored provider authority is checked both inside the locked transaction and again after the allow audit commits, immediately before return; a post-commit advance appends a separate redacted authority_generation_stale denial transaction, and injected denial-audit failure rejects with a durable authorization_store_error rather than returning allow. Production gateway persistence now constructs createPostgresFleetAuthorizationContextResolver from the runtime pool, session pepper, config, exact nonempty manifest companion IDs, and provider revocation port, then passes it to GatewayFleetAuthBroker. Gateway main validates the fleet manifest before initialization and derives/passes companion IDs; principalAuthenticationWired remains false in main and api-surface. Enabled composition reaches the resolver and returns session_absent for a valid empty-database request; disabled mode returns before resolver construction even with an empty companion list. No migrations, schema, routes, or public principal authentication were added. Regression-first proof reproduced 6 intended failures out of 53 before production changes. Final combined remediation plus original focus plus gateway composition/legacy guard gate passed 7 files and 82/82 tests. npm run build passed including DTS; mandatory npm run lint passed; git diff --check passed. Exact UBS v5.3.5 at scanner commit 48fe6099 scanned all 8 changed files: 30 critical, 38 warnings, 446 informational, all adjudicated generic false positives or existing test fixtures: status/decision comparisons misclassified as secret comparisons, one test-only client-secret fixture, typed or throw-narrowed deep access, and switch cases that all return. Optional repository hygiene remains blocked only by unrelated feature-base debt: public-sanitize live-host aliases at docs/operations.md:417 and src/app/e2e/kube-self-update-e2e.test.ts:24; dependency-cycle and hardcoded-setting checks likewise list no changed remediation seam. Expected .5.2 integration requirement: gateway-persistence.ts will conflict with its v13 session/provider/counter work. Preserve this resolver factory wiring and exact knownCompanionIds input while adapting authorization-context-store snapshot joins and comparisons to .5.2 exact session-provider provenance plus per-companion binding/grant/policy counters and fencing; reconcile its lock order with the post-commit external-floor recheck. This commit intentionally adds no compatibility shim or migration and the Bead remains in_progress for integration review.

title: Gate Discord member intent on configured evidence mappings
description: Summary: The OPL1.4 production wiring currently starts Discord evidence lifecycle whenever fleet-auth persistence exists, even when no Discord evidence mappings are configured. That causes src/channels/discord/adapter.ts to request the privileged GuildMembers intent in feature-off deployments and can disconnect otherwise-valid bots whose portal configuration does not enable that intent. Fix src/app/gateway/main.ts and the Discord adapter lifecycle boundary so privileged observation is enabled only when at least one validated evidence mapping requires it. Preserve byte-equivalent feature-off behavior and fail closed when configured evidence is incomplete. Scope: production lifecycle/intent gating and focused tests. Non-goals: changing evidence permission semantics or adding new fallback authority.
acceptance_criteria: With discordEvidenceMappings empty or evidence disabled, the adapter does not request GuildMembers and evidence lifecycle does not start; existing non-evidence Discord connectivity remains unchanged. With one or more valid mappings, lifecycle starts and GuildMembers is requested as required. Configuration changes/reconnect paths cannot leave privileged observation enabled after mappings become empty. Focused production-wiring and adapter tests, build, and mandatory npm run lint pass.
notes: Implemented in c8507a6197e8670a554e5a7a79d14cf52f9e119f. Gateway persistence now constructs and starts Discord evidence runtime/lifecycle only when validated mappings are non-empty; adapter GuildMembers and member/thread partials are gated by the same production signal, and gateway registration occurs only when lifecycle exists. Targeted command ran exactly once and passed 2 files / 61 tests: npm test -- --run src/channels/discord/adapter.test.ts src/persistence/postgres/fleet-auth/gateway-persistence.integration.test.ts. The final two-commit worktree also passed npm run build and npm run lint exactly once. Left in_progress for orchestrator integration/review; not closed.

Evidence: commit/stat and current gateway persistence/composition were read; Discord evidence runtime/lifecycle is constructed and adapter observation enabled only when validated mappings are non-empty, while feature-off bots retain their existing intent surface. The one focused run passed 2 files / 61 tests; worker build and lint passed. title: P1: Pin fleet migration paths and retire the verified source inode
description: Summary: final DNLL review found migration containment/hash checks occur before later pathname-based ensure/link/open/unlink operations. Ancestor or receipt directory symlink swaps can redirect publication, receipt loading follows symlinks, and a source replacement between final hash and unlink can cause deletion of changed/unapproved data. Scope: pin and validate system/receipt/destination directories and file identities for the full operation using descriptor/inode-safe primitives; never follow symlinked receipt or ancestor components. Stage/publish inside migration-owned private directories under pinned destination handles. Retire the exact approved source by atomically moving it into a receipt-owned private quarantine, then re-verify inode/digest/size after the move before marking retired; on changed/replaced source, preserve data and deny. Receipt publication and verification must be durable under the pinned receipt directory. Add directory swap, receipt symlink, ancestor symlink, final-check-to-retirement replacement, and crash/retry tests. Non-goals: no pathname check-then-mutate, deletion of mismatched data, overwrite/merge, or dependence on cooperative external writers for correctness.
acceptance_criteria: Receipt, staging, destination publication, verification, and source retirement remain bound to the originally validated directories/inodes despite ancestor/path swaps. Any source content/inode replacement before retirement is preserved and denied; only the exact approved source is moved into durable receipt-owned quarantine and then recorded retired. Receipt/ancestor/leaf/temp symlinks and pre-existing conflicts deny without writes outside roots. Crash/retry remains deterministic across quarantine/receipt completion. Focused adversarial migration tests and npm run lint pass.
close_reason: Completed and integrated: commit 9a1618a2 introduces descriptor/inode-pinned filesystem primitives and routes receipt, staging, destination publication, verification, and source retirement through them in src/persistence/pinned-filesystem.ts and src/persistence/system-owner-fleet-migration-{execution,io,receipt}.ts. Exact approved sources are renamed into receipt-owned quarantine and reverified before durable retirement; symlink/path swap/replacement/crash regressions are in src/persistence/system-owner-fleet-migration.test.ts. Commit 8427741b additionally fsyncs recovered quarantine state before completion. Both commits are ancestors of the feature branch; the assembled DNLL review reported no remaining P0/P1/Charter issue, and reconciled build/lint pass.

title: P1: Separate runtime owner preflight from seed-fixture verification
description: Summary: final DNLL review found scripts/verify-startup-owner-files.ts creates a disposable seed fixture and assigns DATA_DIR whenever no root env is explicit. The standard launcher invokes that same script, so it may report validation passed against the decoy while the real default runtime roots are missing/malformed, or force forbidden shared-root production mode. Scope: split repository seed/schema verification from runtime preflight into explicit modes/entrypoints. Launcher preflight must always resolve and validate the exact same topology/roots the following gateway process will use, including legal defaults, with no fixture injection. Repository gates may build an isolated split system+companion fixture explicitly and prove registry seed validity. Update package scripts and launcher integration tests to execute real no-explicit-root/default-root paths. Non-goals: no DATA_DIR production fallback, hidden temp authority, or skipped owner validation.
acceptance_criteria: Launcher preflight and gateway resolve identical system/companion/fleet roots for explicit and default layouts; missing/malformed real owners fail before start and no disposable fixture can make them pass. Repository seed verification uses an explicit isolated split fixture and cannot be invoked accidentally by launcher. Tests execute the real verifier through launcher for no-root defaults, explicit split roots, multi-companion roots, and missing/malformed cases. verify:startup-owner-files and npm run lint pass.
close_reason: Completed and integrated: commit 001395ea splits scripts/preflight-startup-owner-files.ts (real loadConfig/runtime roots) from scripts/verify-startup-owner-files.ts (explicit isolated repository-seed fixture), and scripts/start-gateway-agent.sh invokes only the runtime preflight. src/app/maintenance/script-verification/start-gateway-agent.test.ts exercises legal defaults, explicit split roots, fleet roots, and missing/malformed owners through the real verifier. On the reconciled feature branch the focused owner/launcher suite passed 65/65, verify:startup-owner-files passed, build passed, and npm run lint passed; independent DNLL final review found no remaining blocking issue in this seam.

title: P1: Validate nested Garden turn events without assertion casts
description: Summary: Garden WebSocket envelope normalization leaves event.data unknown, then prompt-monitor checks only two root strings and casts it to PersistedTurnSnapshot. Nested providerWireMessages, activeTools, prompt context, and related collections are later dereferenced with map, so malformed event values can throw through the uncaught event-bus subscriber instead of being rejected. Scope: add a focused total parser/validator for the persisted turn snapshot/event payload using canonical shared guards and exact allowed fields; normalize optional nested data without assertion casts or any; reject/log malformed events at the boundary so one event cannot kill the subscriber path. Reuse validation across replay/live paths. Non-goals: no permissive coercion, silent fallback, or duplicate domain policy.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed root or nested turn event payloads—including non-array providerWireMessages/activeTools, malformed messages/tools/context, unknown discriminants, and prototype/unknown-field cases—are rejected and surfaced without throwing out of the event subscriber or mutating monitor state. Valid slim/full events preserve semantics. No unchecked PersistedTurnSnapshot assertion or equivalent remains at the WebSocket boundary. Focused adversarial event tests, Garden check/build, and npm run lint pass.

They enforce exact records/prototypes/unknown fields, canonical discriminants, correlation identity, and all nested provider/tool/context/plan structures; malformed live payloads surface via onRejectedSnapshot without throwing or mutating monitor state. Adversarial parser coverage includes slim/full/explicit-empty, malformed arrays/messages/tools, prototype pollution, unknown fields, and identity mismatch. Garden check/build, focused tests, root build/lint, and final independent review pass.

title: P1: Preserve plan-derived semantics in slim Garden snapshots
description: Summary: prompt-monitor cloneSnapshot currently coerces absent providerWireMessages and activeTools to empty arrays. Core defines absent activeTools as a signal to derive from the retained plan; promptLoom/server projection is optional. In the fallback path, the coerced empty arrays are consumed as authoritative and a slim plan-backed turn can display false empty provider payload/tools rather than deriving them. The added regression deletes wire messages on a pre-plan fixture and incorrectly blesses []. Scope: preserve undefined versus explicit empty across the boundary, reuse the canonical plan-derivation behavior when server projection is absent, and add fixtures for slim plan-backed turns with missing wire messages/active tools plus explicit-empty cases. Non-goals: no fake defaults or weakening AdminTurn snapshot truth.
acceptance_criteria: Missing providerWireMessages/activeTools remains distinguishable from explicit empty arrays. When promptLoom/server projection is absent, a slim plan-backed turn derives current provider messages/tools from the retained plan exactly as core specifies; explicit empty stays empty. Garden displays truthful state and tests cover plan-backed missing fields, explicit empty, projection present/absent, and immutability. Focused prompt-monitor tests, Garden check/build, and npm run lint pass.
close_reason: Completed and integrated: commit c4a147be preserves undefined versus explicit-empty providerWireMessages/activeTools in Garden snapshots and reuses canonical serializePromptPlanForProvider derivation when projection fields are absent. admin-ui/src/lib/events/prompt-monitor.test.ts covers slim plan-backed derivation, explicit empty authority, projection fallback, and clone immutability. The combined Garden pass completed focused tests, Garden check/build, root build/lint, and independent final review with no P0/P1/Charter finding.

title: P1: Establish one observability call-type authority
description: Summary: Garden repair introduced OBSERVABILITY_CALL_TYPES in src/shared/contracts/runtime.ts but blind review found duplicated value authorities in src/shared/contracts/model-budget.ts, src/primitives/llm/correlation.ts, src/core/turns/observability.ts, src/persistence/sessions/turn-records.ts, and src/operator/garden/telemetry-correlation.ts. Adding or changing a call type can leave runtime validation, budget accounting, persistence, and Garden telemetry disagreeing, violating Charter §12.4. Scope: select one focused shared canonical module/tuple/type guard for observability call types and import it everywhere; remove local literal sets/unions/validators while preserving owner boundaries and avoiding cycles. Check requester provenance for the same class without duplicating already-canonical authority. Non-goals: no widening accepted values, compatibility shims, or unrelated telemetry refactor.
acceptance_criteria: Repository search finds exactly one value authority for observability call types; model budget, LLM correlation, turn observability, turn records, ICP metadata, and Garden telemetry all import/use it and reject unknown values consistently. No dependency cycle or god-contract growth is introduced. Focused validation/persistence/Garden tests, dependency-cycle gate, build, and npm run lint pass.
close_reason: Completed and integrated: commit fe14a003 establishes src/shared/contracts/observability-call-types.ts as the sole tuple/type/guard authority and imports it across model budget, LLM correlation/lane, turn observability, persistence, ICP metadata, model-usage attribution, and Garden telemetry. Repository search confirms one value authority and canonical guard usage; focused correlation validation exists. The combined Garden repair passed root build/lint, Garden check/build, focused tests, and independent final review with no P0/P1/Charter finding.

title: P1: Serialize Discord evidence lifecycle and store generations
description: Summary: Discord evidence event/timer work uses one pending chain, but recordActiveOAuthSession and recordSessionRotation bypass it. Old timer closures have no entry generation/identity check and requireReauthentication deletes whichever newer entry shares the key. PostgreSQL replacement locks the subject while revoke uses an unlocked delete, allowing a concurrent replacement to commit after revoke and leave an untracked positive. Scope: serialize all coordinator mutations, add monotonically unique entry generations/cancellation checks so stale timers and callbacks cannot affect a new login, and make store replace/revoke use the same transaction-scoped principal/provider authority lock and ordering. Revoke-before-refresh must remain fail-closed, close/drain must settle all work, and background errors must not create unhandled orphan authority. Non-goals: no process-local-only lock as the sole database authority and no last-write-wins ambiguity.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic race tests cover old timer vs new login, event revoke vs callback refresh, session rotation vs expiry, close vs event, replace vs revoke in both commit orders, and cross-process-equivalent DB transaction ordering. No stale task can delete a newer entry or reinsert positive evidence after a completed revoke; no orphan positive remains without active lifecycle state; failures deny and surface. Focused concurrency/PostgreSQL tests, build, and npm run lint pass.
notes: 2026-07-16 commit 63632fba: focused concurrency/PostgreSQL tests and npm run build passed. npm run lint found one test-only optional-call issue, corrected afterward without rerun. Final blind review/integration lint pending.
close_reason: Completed in reviewed commit 63632fba and integrated by d92e1357. Evidence: commit history/stat and current coordinator/store code were read; coordinator mutations use the serialized pending chain and generation-bound lifecycle state, while PostgreSQL activation/invalidation share locked authority generations. The worker's focused concurrency/PostgreSQL suite and build passed; the only one-pass lint finding was corrected and the subsequent full integration npm run lint passed. Final independent OPL1.4 review found no P0/P1 or Charter issue, and the first full feature-branch suite reported no Discord evidence lifecycle/runtime failure.

title: P1: Revoke Discord evidence on bot authority loss and disconnect
description: Summary: lifecycle event translation emits bot GuildMemberUpdate as a human subject-scoped member change. The coordinator therefore matches only active OAuth subjects equal to the bot ID and refreshes nobody when the bot gains/loses a role, even though that changes observation authority for every mapped principal. Disconnect/invalidated/shard loss also has no immediate revocation event. Scope: distinguish observer/bot authority events from human-member events, bind the observer identity to the exact companion adapter, revoke all affected companion positives before recomputation, and immediately revoke on disconnect/invalidated/unavailable states until a fresh ready/current observation succeeds. Cover bot role assignment, bot removal, direct permission overwrite/channel visibility, and private-thread observation loss. Non-goals: no global cross-companion revocation when only one adapter changes and no cached-positive fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Bot role assignment/removal, guild removal, disconnect/invalidated/unavailable, channel overwrite visibility loss, and private-thread observation loss promptly revoke every affected positive for only that companion. Reconnect/ready may restore only after current complete OAuth+bot evidence. Human subject events remain scoped. Production event-source regression tests, cross-companion isolation tests, build, and npm run lint pass.
notes: 2026-07-16 commit 36d8833c: focused observer-loss/event tests, npm run build, and npm run lint passed. Final blind review pending.
close_reason: Completed in commit 36d8833c and integrated by d92e1357. Evidence: commit/stat plus current event source and tests were read; bot member events are distinguished as observer authority, disconnect/invalidated/shard loss emits immediate observer-unavailable revocation, reconnect emits readiness, and companion-scoped coordinator handling preserves isolation. Focused observer-loss/event tests, build, and npm run lint passed on the worker commit. Final independent OPL1.4 review found no P0/P1 or Charter issue; the first integration suite had no related failures.

title: P1: Enforce Discord-evidence reauthentication at session issuance
description: Summary: OPL1.4 lifecycle records an in-memory reauthentication reason when OAuth guild/member evidence is unavailable, invalid, expired, or session-bound renewal fails, but reauthenticationReason has no production caller. GatewayFleetAuthBroker creates/rotates an active session before the lifecycle result, FleetAuth routes set the cookie, and no denial/revocation prevents use. Scope: make lifecycle admission return a typed allow/reauth-required outcome; broker callback and rotation must atomically or compensating-transaction revoke/fence any just-created session and return a stable reauthentication-required denial before a cookie is emitted. Wire exact reason to the fleet-auth HTTP/UI contract without leaking provider details. Expiry timers must fence server authority, not merely retain an in-memory flag. First-owner activation must enter the same lifecycle or explicitly require a new OAuth ceremony. Non-goals: no bearer fallback, no legacy token, and no active fleet session that silently lacks required Discord evidence when mappings apply.
acceptance_criteria: Provider membership outage/malformed evidence during callback produces no usable active cookie/session; rotation/expiry/first-owner activation with unavailable evidence revokes/fences server authority and returns an explicit reauthentication-required response. A later valid OAuth ceremony can recover. Tests cover callback, cookie emission, rotation, expiry, first owner, concurrent failure, audit redaction, and feature-off parity. Focused broker/route/lifecycle tests, build, and npm run lint pass.
notes: 2026-07-16 commit aef5b3b2: 53/56 selected focused tests passed; only three unrelated backup tests failed because pg_dump is unavailable (spawn pg_dump ENOENT). All broker, route, lifecycle, schema migration, and new PostgreSQL fencing tests passed. npm run build and npm run lint passed. Final blind review pending.
close_reason: Completed in commit aef5b3b2 and integrated by d92e1357. Evidence: commit/stat and current broker/route/session-store paths were read; lifecycle admission yields a typed reauthentication-required denial, broker compensation fences server-side sessions, routes suppress cookie issuance and expose the stable denial, and Postgres fencing records the authority change. Worker evidence passed every broker/route/lifecycle/schema/fencing test (53/56 total; only 3 external pg_dump backup cases failed), plus build and lint. Final independent OPL1.4 review found no P0/P1 or Charter issue; the branch integration suite showed no related regression.

title: Own lifecycle and Kubernetes self-management operational limits in canonical settings
description:
Context: psfn-framework-xv84 found operational policy spread across src/system/lifecycle/command-runner.ts, kube-helm-rollback.ts, kube-rollout-restart.ts, kube-post-rollout-validation.ts, kube-post-rollout-validation-store.ts, kube-rollback-store.ts, src/app/operator/kube-self-update-transport.ts, src/app/operator/kube-self-update-validation-transport.ts, and src/boundary/gateway/kubernetes-read-api.ts plus kubernetes-rollout-api.ts. The mutable values include command/request timeouts, readiness wait and poll cadence, validation log count, and bounded history retention. Live composition in src/app/agent/control-plane.ts, src/boundary/gateway/kube-self-management-runtime.ts, and src/app/operator/kube-self-update-job-main.ts either repeats literals or takes module defaults.

Scope: design one coherent group in the appropriate existing canonical JSON owner for lifecycle/Kubernetes operational policy; add strict parser/types/seed values; pass them through every real agent, gateway, and operator-job composition; make bounded history stores accept owner-provided retention without losing atomicity; expose the fields through Garden; and add focused contract and reachability tests. Keep host/port/socket and credential wiring in env where already env-owned.

Non-goals: do not move Kubernetes response/body size DoS caps, credential/header length guards, DNS/protocol grammar, or other immutable safety ceilings into mutable settings; do not add a lifecycle.json owner or legacy env fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical owner settings control all listed timeouts, wait/poll cadence, validation log count, and history retention in live agent/gateway/operator-job paths; malformed values reject and production has no silent fallback; Garden and seed/default contracts cover them; temporary xv84 deferred baseline notes are removed while genuine size/protocol guards remain documented; npm run verify:settings-contract, npm run verify:hardcoded-settings, targeted lifecycle/Kubernetes tests, npm run lint, npm run build, and git diff --check pass.
notes: Implemented in 1ac4cc81. Added strict settings.json lifecycleKubernetes policy, seed and Garden exposure; wired lifecycle restart, operator command/HTTP/confirmation transports, gateway Kubernetes read/rollout transports, rollout/rollback waits, post-rollout log count, and durable validation/rollback retention. Removed all 13 zhg9 temporary baseline entries while preserving immutable size/protocol guards. Validation: 159 focused tests passed, npm run lint passed, npm run build passed, verify:settings-contract passed, verify:hardcoded-settings passed, git diff --check passed.
close_reason: Completed in 1ac4cc81 with canonical settings ownership and live agent/gateway/operator reachability; 159 focused tests, full lint/build, both settings verifiers, and diff check passed.

title: Own committed voice segmenter thresholds in canonical runtime settings
description:
Context: psfn-framework-xv84 found mutable defaults in src/primitives/voice/reply-stream/segmenter.ts for minimum segment length and maximum buffered length. The pure segmenter already accepts SegmenterConfig, but the live API voice path at src/channels/api/voice-websocket-runtime.ts constructs createAgentReplyStreamBridge without a segmenter config, so production takes module policy.
